items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Al Killian and Willie Smith and them didn't know what Bird was playing... When they did 'Lady Be Good' and shit, that was bad! That was cut in '46. ... Al Killian.

ctx.x: Willie Smith, yourself, Bird and Prez.

Yeah. I felt sorry for everybody after Bird got through playing. I said, "Pshew!" Because Al Killian and Willie Smith and them didn't know what Bird was playing. They didn't have the slightest idea. When Bird got through with it, I said, "Damn, man!" Because Prez didn't want to follow him. Prez followed him, man. Yeah, Prez followed him, but nobody wanted to follow him! Ha. And Willie Smith and those guys... If I was him, I would have said, "No, you've got it, man! You go ahead and play the tune. I don't need to…
